title: Kissed Crunchy Turkish Lentils Pilaf
description: A macrobiotic-friendly and flavorful pilaf featuring speculaas spice mix, crunchy texture from sesame seeds, and a pungent aroma from the nimono-simmered onions. Perfect for meal prep and a satisfying lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.

Add the vegetable broth, lentils, and speculaas spice mix to the saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils and rice are tender.
While the pilaf is cooking, toast the sesame seeds in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and fragrant.
Once the pilaf is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the toasted sesame seeds, and additional speculaas spice mix to taste.
